description: What a Japanese law is for, who it applies to, and its chapters and articles. One law: titles, number, kind, when the text in force took effect, the texts held (versions: in force, not yet in force, no longer in force, each with the days it stands), how much of it has the Ministry's English, and this site's plain description of it — what it is for, who it applies to and who it does not, and on request (aspect) its exceptions and how it is enforced — each claim with the provisions it rests on (basis). Then its outline: by default the parts and chapters of the main text (編, 章); outline "articles" lists every article (for a very long law, its headings instead), and under (a heading's path, such as ch-4) lists everything under that heading. outlineUrl turns an outline path into its page.

aspect.description: One part of the description, in full: summary, applies, excludes, exceptions, enforcement or topics. Unset gives summary, applies, excludes and topics, and names the others in description.more.

lang.description: The language of the pages every url opens, and of the card get_provision is drawn as: "en" (default) or "ja". The text returned always holds both languages.

law.description: The law: its Japanese title (労働基準法), English title (Labor Standards Act), short name (労基法), slug (labor-standards-act) or e-Gov law ID (322AC0000000049).

under.description: A heading's or run's path from the outline, such as ch-4 or from-art-31: list everything under it.

name: get_law
title: Describe one law
